run_unispeechsat_model: run the UniSpeechSatModel to extract hidden states from audio input values with optional attention mask
build_unispeechsat_pretraining: build a UniSpeechSatForPreTraining model with vector-quantization and gumbel softmax for self-supervised audio learning
run_unispeechsat_ctc: run the UniSpeechSatForCTC model for automatic speech recognition using connectionist temporal classification loss
run_unispeechsat_classification: run the UniSpeechSatForSequenceClassification model to classify audio inputs into target label categories
compute_contrastive_logits: compute contrastive logits for pretraining using cosine similarity between target and predicted audio features
